annotations.title: Infer a JSON Schema from samples

description: Generate a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) from one or more sample JSON values: types (integer vs number, mixed types as a type list), "null" added where a value can be null, required = keys present in every sample object, array items merged across all elements, string formats guessed when every sample matches (date-time, date, email, uri, uuid), and optional enums for small repeated string sets. Give "samples" (an array of sample values), or "text" (JSON, or JSONL = one sample per line), or "file" (path or base64 of a .json/.jsonl file). An array sample describes an array; to treat its elements as separate samples set eachItem. Pure local code; optionally writes the schema to "output".

additionalProperties.description: false adds additionalProperties: false to every object (strict). Default true (left open).

eachItem.description: If the only sample is an array, use its elements as the samples (schema of one record). Default false.

enums.description: Emit "enum" for string fields with few distinct values that repeat. Default false.

file.description: Or: a .json/.jsonl file (local path or base64).

maxEnumValues.description: Largest string set turned into an enum (default 8).

output.description: Optional: also write the schema as a .json file here.

required.description: List keys present in every sample as "required" (default true).

samples.description: Sample values; each element is one sample.

text.description: Or: JSON text (one sample) or JSONL (one sample per line).

name: ai_json_schema_infer
